description: Minister of Lab our and Foreign Employment - Cancel Extra gazette No. 2385/14 of 21st 05. 2024 The Wages Boards for the Tea Growing and Manufacturing Trade. - Cancel Extra gazette No.2385/14 of 21.05.2024 The Wages Boards For the Rubber Cultivation and Raw Rubber Processing Trade.
reasoning: This gazette content involves the cancellation of notifications regarding minimum wage determinations under the Wages Boards Ordinance. It deals with regulatory matters (specifically labor regulations and wage determinations) and references statutory instruments (the Wages Boards Ordinance), making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5).
